title: Lab 2A — private Fargate (part 2)
topic: ECS Fargate awsvpc networking, execution vs task role, private subnet RunTask, troubleshooting
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-10-lab-fargate-run.sh. Answer without peeking at night-10-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You run ecs:RunTask for globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-iceland with assignPublicIp DISABLED in the Night 9 private subnets. The task stays PENDING then stops with CannotPullContainerError. The Fargate security group allows egress TCP 443 only. What should you verify first?

options.A: Add an inbound rule on the Fargate SG for ECR on port 443
options.B: Move the task to a public subnet with assignPublicIp ENABLED
options.C: Private route table routes 0.0.0.0/0 to the NAT Gateway and the NAT is available
options.D: Attach an Internet Gateway directly to the private subnet

questions.question: The Iceland task definition lists executionRoleArn globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-ecs-execution and taskRoleArn globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-ecs-task. Which role must allow ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and image layer pulls before the container starts?

options.A: Task role — the running application pulls its own image
options.B: Execution role — ECS agent pulls the image on behalf of the task
options.C: GitHub Actions deploy user — only CI/CD may touch ECR
options.D: ECS service-linked role for the cluster

questions.question: The Iceland container sets REGION=iceland and S3_BUCKET=globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output. The task starts and pulls the image successfully but fails when uploading pipeline output. Which IAM principal needs s3:PutObject on the bucket?

options.A: Execution role — all runtime AWS API calls use it
options.D: Task role — application code uses task credentials for S3

questions.question: Task logConfiguration uses awslogs with group /ecs/globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-iceland. The task stops with ResourceInitializationError mentioning CloudWatch Logs. The execution role has AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy attached. What is the most likely remaining issue?

options.A: Network path to CloudWatch Logs endpoints (NAT or logs VPC endpoint) — same egress as ECR
options.C: Security group needs inbound UDP 514 for syslog
options.D: Fargate tasks cannot use awslogs in private subnets

questions.question: You have not yet added an S3 gateway endpoint to the study VPC. A Fargate task in private subnets with NAT writes large objects to S3 in the same Region. How does that S3 traffic leave the VPC?

options.A: Stays entirely on the VPC local route — S3 is always private
options.C: Goes out via NAT Gateway to the S3 public endpoint (NAT data-processing charges apply)
options.D: Blocked unless you add inbound 443 to the task security group

questions.question: After Night 10 you want zero NAT traffic for both ECR image pulls and S3 uploads from private Fargate tasks. Which minimum endpoint set matches week2-vpc-plan.md?

options.C: Interface endpoints for ecr.api and ecr.dkr plus an S3 gateway endpoint on the private route table
options.D: Internet Gateway route added to the private route table

questions.question: A colleague argues the Fargate SG is wrong because there are no inbound rules and the task cannot receive responses from ECR. What is the correct response?

options.A: Add inbound 443 from the NAT Gateway security group
options.B: Security groups are stateful — return traffic for allowed outbound connections is permitted automatically
options.C: Fargate requires inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 for TLS handshakes
options.D: Disable the security group entirely for private tasks

questions.question: night-10-lab-fargate-run.sh passes subnets from night-9-vpc-ids.json and assignPublicIp DISABLED. A task ENI is created in one of the listed private subnets. Can a user on the public internet SSH to the task's private IP through the NAT Gateway?

options.A: Yes — NAT forwards inbound connections to matching private IPs
options.B: Yes — if the execution role has ssm:StartSession
options.C: Yes — after adding an IGW route to the private subnet
options.D: No — NAT provides outbound-only internet access from the private subnet's perspective

questions.question: GitHub Actions calls ecs:RunTask with iam:PassRole on globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-ecs-execution and globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-ecs-task. Why is PassRole required?

options.A: ECS must assume those roles when starting the task on your behalf
options.B: PassRole lets GitHub clone the ECR repository locally
options.C: PassRole replaces the need for a task security group
options.D: PassRole only applies to EC2 launch type, not Fargate

questions.question: After night-10-lab-fargate-run.sh completes, you confirm success. Which pair of checks best validates the lab besides exit code 0?

options.A: CloudWatch log stream under /ecs/globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-iceland and new objects in globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output
options.B: NAT Gateway deleted and IGW detached
options.C: Task received a public Elastic IP on the ENI
options.D: Fargate SG shows inbound rules from 0.0.0.0/0
